connector.notes:
Curated by the methodology author. Each row is a discrete policy issue
with a stipulated stance spectrum (left vs right pole) used as the
scoring axis. Adding a topic is a row edit.

compiler_notes: Stance direction is stipulated, not derived from an external authority. Reader must understand the scale is a framing choice, not a normative truth claim.
